detail: Long 39920-token averages: output kernel 4318.312ms, local triangular 2158.513ms, local-old cancellation 1845.641ms, D/prior setup 21.825ms, cast/store 0.817ms.

Opt-in block-scan output kernel consumes c_state_total_exact and assembles candidate output; default sequential SSD is separate.
D skip, c_state_total_exact prior, BF16 cast, and store are already measured as small and must stay unchanged.
For each output row and d lane, the kernel loops u from chunk_start through t and recomputes scalar C/B reductions that are independent of d.
Current local triangular path computes cb = reverse-order dot(C[t], B[u]) then BF16(cb * decay * dt_u_scale) before multiplying by x[u,d].
Current local-old path computes old_state_source = forward-order dot(C[t], BF16(B[u] * dt_u)) then applies decay and x[u,d].
Sequential oracle uses the same u-order local_old_state and local_hf_chunk_scan accumulation; any accepted optimization must preserve this order.
Aggregate local_old_state_exact fixed row97 but regressed row82, so the next design must not replace per-u cancellation with a recurrent aggregate.
Accepted branch after cleanup: c_state_total_exact retained, local-old recomputed in output order, row97/row64/row82 probes exact.
